title: Pumpkins Enhanced
body:
This is a resource pack for enhancing pumpkins and anything related to them including melons.

The textures felt old and looked like they needed an update, so I created a pack with LabPBR support that doesn’t look weird without shaders.

Pumpkins will have a more natural vine when they grow instead of sticking to their side. Pumpkin pie, pumpkin seeds and other items are more accurate to what they should be.

It also improves visibility when equipping carved pumpkins without completely removing them.
